newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weaker, but Algerian cargoes placed.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weaker, but Algerian cargoes placed.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were weaker with crude on Monday, but traders said the market looked better balanced with all of the November Algerian cargoes placed.
Three of the 50,000 to 60,000 tonne cargoes had been taken up by petrochemical users while the third was in the hands of Brazil's Petrobras and will probably go transatlantic.
"There's not a great deal of demand, most players are now covered, and the market looks better balanced," trader said.
Traders saw pockets of top-up demand for paraffinic grades but expected prices to continued to drift lower with crude.
